tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all website projects (domains) in the user's Traffalyzer account, including their domain id, URL, plan status (free or paid) and the latest scan result with its overall score. Call this first — every domain-scoped tool needs a domain id from this list.

tools.name: next_actions
tools.description: The prioritised to-do list across ALL of the user's domains in a single call: critical and high-severity issues, open quests, the next unfinished growth-plan step, projects with a missing or stale scan, and missing integrations. Start here when the user asks what to improve, what to do next, or to '

tools.name: run_scan
tools.description: Start a new SEO/UX scan (crawl) for one of the user's domains. Scans run asynchronously and usually take a few minutes; poll get_scan_status for progress and the resulting scores. If a scan is already in progress, its id is returned instead of starting a duplicate.

tools.name: get_scan_status
tools.description: Status and results of the most recent scan of a domain: whether it is pending, running, completed or failed, the overall score and its sub-scores (technical, on-page, engagement, AI visibility), pages crawled and the number of issues found.

tools.name: search_console_queries
tools.description: Keyword data from Google Search Console for one domain. intent=top returns the strongest keywords, intent=opportunities keywords ranking on positions 5-20 with potential, intent=movers the biggest winners and losers versus the previous period of equal length. Requires the user to have connected Sear

tools.name: keyword_history
tools.description: Month-by-month history of a single keyword from Google Search Console (clicks, impressions, impression-weighted position) plus the pages ranking for it. Use it to see how a query developed, whether it is seasonal, or which page Google shows for it. Pass the query exactly as Search Console lists it.

tools.name: search_console_pages
tools.description: Page-level Search Console performance for one domain: which pages get clicks and impressions, at which average position. Useful to find the pages that carry the organic traffic and the ones that underperform. Responses follow the account language (German by default).

tools.name: page_report
tools.description: A full report for a single page of the domain: search performance, analytics behavior (sessions, bounce rate, engagement time where connected), page classification and its top search queries. Responses follow the account language (German by default).

tools.name: traffic_trend
tools.description: Search performance over time for the whole site or a single page — is it getting better or worse, did a change have an effect. Weekly by default, daily with granularity=day when an exact date matters. Includes Plausible visitor data for the same buckets where the integration is connected. Responses

tools.name: timeline_events
tools.description: Dated events on the site's history timeline: measures the user logged themselves, completed quests, fixed issues, ticked plan steps, CMS edits, detected wins, scans and Google ranking updates (core, spam …) with their rollout dates. Use it to explain why a curve moved, what was changed when, or whet

tools.name: log_measure
tools.description: Log a change the user made to their website themselves (e.g. 'added internal links to /blog/x', 'new images in the guide') on the history timeline. Traffalyzer then measures its effect automatically: 28 days before vs. 28 days after, adjusted for the rest of the site. Backdating is allowed up to 16

tools.name: growth_plan
tools.description: The domain's current growth plan: diagnosis, bottleneck, phases and steps. Without a stepKey the structure with all step keys is returned; with a stepKey the full step including rationale, implementation guidance and verification status. On free domains some step details are locked. Responses follow

tools.name: quests_and_issues
tools.description: The domain's task list: quests (concrete recommendations with implementation guidance and XP rewards) and issues (technical findings from the latest crawl with affected URLs). tools.description: Mark one of the user's quests as implemented after the recommended change has actually been made. Awards the quest's XP and starts result verification.
